name: The Joy Factory aXtion Extreme iPad mini
removable: No (certificate: do not open the enclosure; iPad replacement through Joy Factory only)
summary: The Joy Factory aXtion Extreme iPad mini is a flameproof (Ex d) case for the iPad mini (A17 Pro), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. The tablet inside is a standard iPad mini (A17 Pro) running iPadOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management.
imageAlt: The Joy Factory aXtion Extreme iPad mini, front view

otherSchemes: TS (Taiwan) per an earlier research note
not re-verified. RoHS and REACH compliant (datasheet).

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T85°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2025-04-14), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not verified

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T6 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T85°C Db

certification.ambient: −20 °C to +40 °C (standard range: no Ta is marked on IECEx TPS 25.0016X, so IEC 60079-0 applies)

safety.conditions: 1) Do not open the enclosure (opening voids certification; contact Joy Factory if the iPad needs replacing). 2) I/O port fully engaged after charging and locking lever latched in use. 3) Protect glass window from impact energy above 2 J. 4) Do not charge in a potentially flammable environment. 5) Fasteners with yield stress 240 MPa or more. 6) Screws not to be removed; replace only with SUS 304 M4x6 / M4x8, torque 8 kgf-cm. 7) Rubber bumpers must be fitted at all times and inspected before each use. 8) Flameproof joints are not intended to be repaired. 9) Remove from service if the enclosure, screen or rear camera window is cracked or deformed or bumpers are missing.
safety.peripherals: Stainless I/O port with latch: user may dismantle it to charge in a non-hazardous area; must be fully engaged and latched before use in the Ex area
safety.certifiedAccessories: Premium adjustable anti-static leather hand strap (included), shoulder strap ports, VESA 75 and 1/4-20 mounting. Ex rating of straps and mounts not stated separately; the certificate covers the enclosure.

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least October 2029 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 8.3-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, P3, True Tone, fully laminated, antireflective coating
specs.camera: 12 MP Wide, f/1.8, True Tone flash
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi (9 hours cellular)
specs.ports: USB-C (USB 3, 10 Gb/s); magnetic Apple Pencil connector
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.network: Wi-Fi only or Wi-Fi + Cellular (5G sub-6 GHz)
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C); hover
